title: Battle Angel Alita: Last Order
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Resurrected by the mad scientist Desty Nova in the floating city Tiphares, cyborg fighter Alita searches for her friend Lou and her own past. She uncovers that citizens' brains have been replaced with chips, travels into space amid conflict between the solar system's powers, and fights in a ten-yearly tournament, the Zenith of Things.
life_message: Identity and human dignity are worth fighting for, even when bodies and minds can be rebuilt.

winners_losers: The story ends at Ketheres with Alita's legacy revealed (ANN); sympathy goes to Alita's fight for identity against controlling powers.
